checks: source request returns its durable intent before capturing app source
actual source capture runs in a worker while the utility host processes heartbeats
diff, frozen validation preparation and proposal export stay off the host event loop
whole preparation and proposal work share the builder's admission through actual worker exit
exact patch changes only its scoped candidate and preserves the original source file
source proposal explicitly retains pending Windows build and app preview
limitations: Public checkout captured by actual source workers in an Electron utility process; optional ASAR modules are loaded by the fixture, rather than enabling installed source repairs.

Model and validator are scripted; this measures host I/O responsiveness and lifecycle, not real-cloud quality, unit conformance, Windows candidate builds, installed source delivery or statistical foreground/whole-day latency.
